correctness.rationale: Derived the transition law by bordering the old rank-normal form: down d_j=(1−q^{−j})², up u_j=q^{−(2j+1)}, hold otherwise. The finite-field rank distribution gives π_0=P∞, with finite expected returns from negative drift. Birth–death harmonic increments give h_k=[∑_{j=0}^{k−1}q^{j(j+2)}P_j²]^{-1}~q^{1−k²}/P∞². Regeneration at zero has mean cycle q/P∞ (including geometric zero waiting); an IID cycle-mark plus renewal-count sandwich gives the Poisson intensity 1/P∞. A summable dyadic upper/lower bound and Borel–Cantelli give almost-sure maximum ∼√(log_q N). Independently verified 21 gambler-ruin formula cases and residual-block rank enumerations; finite results do not imply asymptotics.
